easyPrerequisites:
Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive
You have an additional {4}{W} available, or you have a way to kill a creature.
description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Kill the Fractal, triggering Resourceful Defense, moving the Fractal's counters onto Walking Archive.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, and thus losing the game.
